Name: Shechem
Summary: Shechem was the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince whose assault on Dinah brought destruction on his city.
KeyStory: Shechem took Dinah by force, then asked to marry her — and while his men were weakened by circumcision, Simeon and Levi killed them all.
RelatedPeople: Hamor; Dinah; Jacob; Simeon, Son of Jacob; Levi
LifeLesson: Desire without restraint destroys both the one who takes and everyone around him.
